main_body: A tall brown slab about 32x41 px with a flat olive-green band across its top, a scalloped dark drip edge below the band, and scattered dark and magenta marks on the brown face. It does not read as low furniture.
top_band: Olive-green (L=151) at rows 2-10 (x=8, 16) and rows 2-11 (x=23), under a brown outline row at row 1. The step below it is a dark scalloped run at rows 11-13, not a clean front-edge line.
evidence: The green band is one flat colour, with no lighter front-edge line and no foreshortened surface detail. It reads as a cloth or moss drape or a roof fringe hanging over the face, not a tabletop. The dark scallops under it come close to an eave shadow. The brown front is 27 rows of ragged marks with no inset doors, drawers or openings, and its dark and magenta details are painted flat. The proportions (41 rows tall, 32 wide) do not fit a table, desk, bed or counter, so the kind does not match. There is no clear top-plus-front construction, so it fails.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 5 distinct colours and a median of 5 per tile, against 38-40 colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. Flat-fill coverage is 51%, against 0-13% for the references. All dark edge pixels are neutral (100%), where the references are tinted (1% and 33% neutral). The olive and brown areas are large flat fills with no grain, tile or highlight variation. This is much thinner and flatter than the Beodeul references.
